statements.notes: Top-level directive: the agent follows the core workflow. Can only be partly checked by comparing the trace to the workflow.
Implies the agent must not switch to its own default procedure in place of the workflow.
statements.quote: It OVERRIDES any other problem-solving procedure, including any you would otherwise default to.

statements.notes: Checkable from the tool-call trace: the first task action must read core-workflow.md.
statements.quote: Read /ai-dlc/core-workflow.md before taking any other action on the task.

statements.notes: Ordering rule: reading core-workflow.md comes before any other task action.
statements.quote: Read /ai-dlc/core-workflow.md before taking any other action on the task.

statements.notes: Applies to every stage. The rule detail file for each stage must be read at the start of that stage.
statements.quote: Load that file from /ai-dlc/rule-details/ as the first step of the stage it governs

statements.notes: Ordering: loading the rule detail file is the first step of each stage.
statements.quote: Load that file from /ai-dlc/rule-details/ as the first step of the stage it governs

statements.notes: Each stage's work must follow its rule detail file.
statements.quote: and execute the stage from that file.
statements.target: stage execution per rule detail file

statements.notes: No reading several rule detail files at once.
statements.quote: Load one rule detail file at a time

statements.notes: Each rule detail file is loaded right before its stage starts.
Checkable from the trace: no read of a later stage's rule file before that stage begins.
statements.quote: Do not read ahead to a later stage's rule detail file.

statements.notes: Every stage must produce an artifact. The path is defined in core-workflow.md.
statements.quote: Every stage ends by writing its artifact to the path core-workflow.md specifies

statements.notes: The artifact path must match the one given in core-workflow.md.
statements.quote: writing its artifact to the path core-workflow.md specifies

statements.notes: The artifact is written last, and only after the stage's Completion Criteria are met.
statements.quote: Every stage ends by writing its artifact ... after that stage's Completion Criteria are met.
